Title: Azure Virtual Desktop for Azure Stack HCI public preview is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Virtual Desktop for Azure Stack HCI enables you to:

  • Run latency-sensitive applications on the same network as the users or meet business needs by maintaining data locally instead of in the public cloud.
  • Migrate and modernize traditional VDI workloads to modern cloud technology with a common management strategy across Azure and Azure Stack HCI.
  • Leverage the only hybrid cloud solution that offers full Windows 10 and 11 desktop virtualization plus single or multi-session support for cost-optimization. 

Learn more.
